name: Field of View
description: Validates the maximum in-plane field of view (PixelSpacing x matrix) against a configurable target range: error below the hard minimum, warning outside the target range.
implementation:
pixel_spacing = value["PixelSpacing"].iloc[0]
columns = value["Columns"].iloc[0]
rows = value["Rows"].iloc[0]
fov_col = pixel_spacing[0] * columns
fov_row = pixel_spacing[1] * rows
fov_max = max(fov_col, fov_row)
min_fov = params.get("min_fov_mm")
lo = params.get("target_min_mm")
hi = params.get("target_max_mm")
if min_fov is not None and fov_max < min_fov:
    raise ValidationError(f"FOV too small. Found {fov_max:.0f} mm, need >= {min_fov:g} mm")
if (lo is not None and fov_max < lo) or (hi is not None and fov_max > hi):
    raise ValidationWarning(f"FOV should be within {lo:g}-{hi:g} mm. Found {fov_max:.0f} mm")

testCases.name: 230 mm FOV passes a brain-sized target

parameterDefinitions.name: min_fov_mm
parameterDefinitions.label: Hard minimum FOV
parameterDefinitions.description: Fail if FOV is below this

parameterDefinitions.name: target_min_mm
parameterDefinitions.label: Target FOV minimum
parameterDefinitions.description: Warn if FOV is below this

parameterDefinitions.name: target_max_mm
parameterDefinitions.label: Target FOV maximum
parameterDefinitions.description: Warn if FOV is above this
